name: 卡麦莉加
who: A succubus princess who looks about 18, an adult-looking young noblewoman of a demon imperial house, slim, with two small curved black horns half hidden in her hair. Long wine-red hair with a heavy side-swept fringe, deepening to dark crimson at the tips, large bright ruby-red eyes with a practised, sweet look that hides a sharp mind; a thin gold forehead chain with a small red gem. She stands like someone who knows every room is watching her.
palette: wine red and black, fine antique gold, one small cold blue gem accent
casual: Her princess's travelling dress: a high-collared black velvet bodice-dress closed to the throat with a ring of fine gold chain at the collar, long wine-red sleeves ending in black lace cuffs, a long flared skirt in layered crimson and black, thin black gloves, small ruby drop earrings, ankle boots. A scarlet whip with a tiny bell at its end coils at her waist like a sash. One hand toys with the bell, a sweet, faintly pitiful smile that does not reach the eyes.
private: Away from court eyes: a loose high-necked cream silk blouse with long sleeves tied at the wrist, a long dark crimson skirt, soft flat slippers, the gold chain and earrings taken off, hair brushed over one shoulder with a plain ribbon. She holds a half-eaten pastry in one hand. A tired, honest, unguarded half-smile.
battle: Ready for a fight: a fitted black field coat with a standing collar closed to the throat and a wine-red lining, an asymmetric cut with a longer panel hanging on the right, a row of small gold clasps down the front, the sleeves ending in black leather bracers with a thin line of glowing crimson runes, a pleated crimson skirt over black riding breeches and knee-high laced boots with gold buckles, a short red cape clipped at one shoulder with a small cold blue crystal core, a slim cross belt with a pouch for a communication charm. The scarlet whip is uncoiled in one gloved hand, its small bell glinting, the other hand open in front of her. A light-footed, confident stance and a dangerous little smile.
formal: A diplomatic gala gown of the imperial court: a long black-and-crimson gown with a high lace collar, long sleeves, a gold-embroidered bodice closed to the neck, a train of deep red velvet, long black gloves, a delicate gold tiara chain across the forehead. She stands very straight, chin slightly lifted, a perfect, unreadable courtly smile.
art: A tight head-and-shoulders portrait, the head tilted, glancing sideways at the viewer under the fringe with a sweet smile that is slightly too practised, one gloved fingertip resting against her lower lip. Warm candlelight from one side, a hard-edged shadow of lace tracery falling across her cheek and neck. Foreground blur: drifting dark red rose petals and a hanging chain of tiny bells. She wears the high-collared black velvet dress with the thin gold collar chain.

Long light-brown hair in one thick braid over the shoulder with loose side locks, tied with a big pink ribbon with a small white bead in it, bright green eyes with a teasing look, a soft, friendly face. A bold, warm presence like a flower blooming in the wrong place.
palette: soft rose pink and warm brown, small red jacket accent, fresh green highlights
casual: Her flower-seller's clothes: a long pink dress of layered light cloth closed high at the neckline with a little lace at the collar, a short red jacket with brass trim over it, a slim choker, several bangles on both wrists, short boots worn smooth by stone steps. She carries a white wooden staff wrapped in faded pink cloth, a small bunch of dried flowers tied at its head. One hand extended as if offering a flower, a playful, warm smile.
private: Evening in the ruined chapel garden: an oatmeal knitted cardigan buttoned over a plain white high-necked blouse, a long brown skirt with an apron, soft slippers, the braid loosened. She holds a small watering can in both hands. A quiet, contented smile.
battle: Ready to guard her friends: the red jacket with brass trim worn over a fitted cream-and-pink tunic with a high collar and long sleeves, a leather harness across the chest with small pouches of dried herbs and a row of little glass healing vials, brass-clasped leather bracers, a knee-length flared skirt over soft leather leggings, sturdy lace-up boots with brass toe caps, the big pink ribbon tied tight in her braid. formal: A town festival dress: a long pale rose dress with long sleeves and a modest high neckline, white lace at the cuffs and collar, a green sash at the waist, fresh flowers woven into the braid, simple low shoes. She holds a small posy in both hands, an earnest, slightly shy smile.
art: Reaching one open hand toward the viewer as if handing over a flower, the head tilted, a teasing, gentle smile. Soft light falling through a hole in a roof, hard-edged shadows of old arches and leaf sprigs across her face and braid. Foreground blur: blurred pale lilies and a few drifting pink petals. She wears the pink dress with the red jacket and the big ribbon.

name: 西斯内
who: A 21-year-old woman, a covert agent of a merchant house, 162 cm, slim, quick and exact in her movements. Long copper-red hair with softly curled ends falling behind the shoulders, warm brown eyes, a friendly, soft smile that makes people lower their guard; behind it a very watchful stillness.
palette: black and deep crimson, clean white, one small steel-grey accent
casual: Her agent's working clothes: a fitted black tailored coat with a high collar, half sleeves rolled to the elbow, a crisp white shirt buttoned to the top with a tidy dark-red cravat tied at the throat, a black belt with small pouches, black trousers, ankle boots and black gloves that never come off. A large four-bladed folding throwing ring is slung across her back. One gloved hand rests lightly on a pouch, a polite, gentle smile.

art: A low three-quarter bust, looking up at the viewer from under the fringe, her head slightly tilted, a polite, almost warm smile that does not quite reach the eyes, one gloved hand turning the four-bladed throwing ring near her shoulder. Cold blue night light with warm lantern light behind her, a hard-edged shadow of a stair railing falling across her face. Foreground blur: out-of-focus lantern lights and a fluttering red ribbon. She wears the black coat with the white shirt and dark-red cravat.

name: 艾瑟莉娅

Waist-length pale blonde hair with a faint green sheen, silver at the ends, parted in the middle with a few thin braids, grey-green eyes with flecks of gold, a calm, cool, beautiful face. She stands as if the whole forest is quietly waiting for her to speak.
palette: silver-white and soft moss green, thin gold edging, one small cold blue accent
casual: Her queen's ordinary dress: a long ivory tailored coat-gown with a standing collar closed to the throat, thin gold piping along the edges and sleeves, a pale green inner layer, a silver leaf-pattern embroidered at the shoulders, a slim belt of silver links, ivory gloves, soft pale boots. private: Alone in her chambers: a soft undyed linen robe with a high neck and long sleeves in pale green, a long light-grey wool overgown, bare circlet replaced by a single green ribbon in her loose hair, soft slippers. A composed, unyielding stance with an overwhelming calm.
formal: A royal state gown: a long white-and-silver gown with a high collar, wide sleeves lined in pale green, a long translucent green-gold veil trailing behind, silver leaf embroidery on the bodice, the circlet of living branches across her brow, a cluster of slim silver chains at the collar. She stands perfectly upright, the very picture of a ruler who has waited a hundred years and can wait a hundred more.
art: A tight head-and-shoulders portrait, her head slightly lowered, grey-green eyes looking straight at the viewer, a serene, slightly sad expression. Cool filtered light from above, hard-edged shadows of leaf sprigs falling across her forehead and cheek, a faint glow on the circlet of branches. Foreground blur: drifting luminous leaf fragments and a spray of silver-green foliage. She wears the ivory coat-gown with the standing collar.

name: 布洛姆加
who: An adult dwarf king, looking about 60, short and enormously broad, around 140 cm, with a barrel chest and thick forearms. palette: dark soot-brown and blackened steel, glowing forge orange, one small red-copper accent
casual: His working-king's dress: a heavy dark-brown leather jerkin over a thick wool shirt closed to the neck, a wide leather belt with a testing hammer and rolled drawings hung from it, dark trousers and heavy iron-capped boots, a thick fur-trimmed collar. private: Home by the hearth: an old patched wool tunic with the sleeves rolled to the elbows, a leather apron with burn marks, soft cloth shoes. He holds a small tankard in his left hand and turns a small cracked ring with the copper fingers. A tired, grudgingly warm look.
battle: Full dwarven war plate of the highest forge: black-iron plate armour with heavy copper edging and glowing orange rune lines running along every seam, large pauldrons with a star-shaped crest, a thick gorget, a heavy fur mantle, a furnace core that glows through a grille in the breastplate, the cast mountain-copper right arm fitted into a massive gauntlet with riveted rune plates. formal: The king's full dress: a long heavy black-scaled coat with copper rivets and rune stitching over a wine-red tunic, a short fur-lined mantle with a thick copper clasp, a plain iron crown set with a single red stone, the cast right arm bare of gloves and polished. art: A low-angle broad bust, the great head slightly lowered, amber-grey eyes looking sidelong at the viewer, a stern, thoughtful expression, one huge copper hand lifted holding a small glowing ember between thumb and forefinger. Glowing forge-orange light from below and behind, hard-edged shadows of the beard braids across the chest armour. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a curl of forge smoke. He wears the black-iron plate with the star crest and the fur mantle.

name: 阿蕾缇娅
who: An adult true dragon in human form, looking about 26, tall, 175 cm, slender and poised, with a pair of slim crystalline horns and a long scaled tail. Long straight silver-white hair gathered into a braided crown at the back and falling to the waist, its ends and the horns shimmering faintly with seven colours; pale golden eyes with narrow pupils, a cool, composed, beautiful face. A heavy, ancient calm, as if a great beast is resting in a human-sized room. Her two crystalline horns are a matched PAIR growing from her skull, one above each temple on BOTH sides (viewer's left AND viewer's right when she faces us), slim and swept back, NOT a one-sided hair ornament; both horns are drawn in every panel, in the art and in all nine expression cells. Her golden eyes have narrow vertical dragon pupils (a thin vertical slit) in every panel, never round pupils.
palette: silver-white and pale ice blue, faint prismatic highlights, one small amber-gold accent
casual: Her sanctuary attire: a long white tailored robe-gown with a high standing collar closed to the throat, long sleeves with slim silver edging, a layered cape of pale blue-white scale-patterned cloth on one shoulder, a narrow belt hung with seven small coloured scale-keys, silver gauntlet-gloves, soft white boots. private: In the snow lodge: a soft pale-grey wool robe with a high neck and long sleeves, a thick white knitted scarf, simple fur-lined slippers, hair let down loose. She holds a small steaming bowl in both hands, the tail curled around her ankle. A faint, rare, almost embarrassed smile.
battle: Dragon-sovereign battle gear: a fitted white-and-pale-blue scale armour of overlapping prismatic scales over a high-collared undershirt, shoulder plates edged with silver and set with seven small glowing gems, long sleeves with scaled vambraces, a skirt of split armoured panels over pale leggings, silver-greaved armoured boots, and wide translucent seven-hued wing-membranes unfurled behind her, shedding faint colour onto the floor. A slim silver halberd-staff with a crystal blade held upright in one hand, the other hand open with a ring of glowing coloured light. An unmoving, regal and overwhelming stance.
formal: The dragon lord's audience robe: a long white-silver gown with a high collar, wide sleeves lined in pale prismatic silk, a long train of layered scale-patterned cloth, a thin silver chain with a small coloured scale hung from each horn, white gloves. She holds a thin silver rod in both hands before her. A grave, majestic, patient expression.
art: A close head-and-shoulders portrait from slightly below, the head tilted, golden narrow-pupilled eyes looking down at the viewer with a cool, dangerous calm, one gloved hand brushing a strand of hair past the horn. Cold white light from above, hard-edged shadow of the horn falling across half of her brow, faint coloured refractions on the cheek. Foreground blur: drifting snow and thin prismatic scale fragments. She wears the white high-collared robe-gown with the pale scaled cape.

name: 伊索尔德

Cool blue-white light from the side, hard-edged shadows of water caustics rippling across his face and collar. Foreground blur: drifting droplets and fragments of a broken reflection. He wears the deep-blue high-collared coat with the sapphire pendant.

Warm red-orange glow from below, hard-edged shadow of a scale-edged pauldron falling across half his face. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and flakes of ash.
